renewables.note: Proxy renewable availability; not measured Kerala solar or wind generation.
limitations: Profiles are modelled resource availability, not measured Kerala plant generation.
Representative points are equally weighted and are not a GIS capacity-weighted fleet model.
Wind uses a generic cubic power curve and power-law shear assumption.
PV uses a simple GHI/temperature derate rather than a plant-specific tilt/inverter model.
ERA5 can be used as a later cross-check once full FY2024-25 coverage is acquired.

source.title: Kerala Energy Transition Roadmap 2040
source.citation: CSTEP. (2024). Kerala Energy Transition Roadmap 2040. CSTEP-RR-2024-01.

extraction.rule: Preserve published values exactly; do not silently reconcile, correct or promote them to Kerala 2040 model truth.
extraction.known_rounding_issue: Some appendix component rows differ from published totals by 1-2 MU or MW; published totals are preserved.

load_chronology.key_statement: CSTEP analysed observed Kerala 15-minute data for FY2016, derived an FY2022 load curve, then extrapolated the shape to FY2040.
load_chronology.use_rule: Do not digitise the plotted curve and call it measured telemetry. The underlying FY2016 15-minute series must be acquired separately.

high_re.thermal_import_reduction: approximately 6 percent year-on-year from FY2025 to FY2040

storage.warning: The reported GWh values imply extremely long storage durations. Preserve as published and verify the original storage-calculation definition before using as a model target.

techno_economics.source: CEA and CERC official publications listed below
techno_economics.price_basis_rule: Preserve each source's stated cost basis. Do not interpolate or promote a published benchmark into a Kerala 2040 model input until a documented harmonisation method is chosen.

cea_optimal_mix_2029_30_v2.title: Report on Optimal Generation Capacity Mix for 2029-30, Version 2.0
cea_optimal_mix_2029_30_v2.note: Values below are transcribed only from the verified CEA tables. They are external national-planning assumptions, not selected Kerala 2040 costs.

cerc_re_tariff_2024.title: CERC Terms and Conditions for Tariff determination from Renewable Energy Sources Regulations, 2024
cerc_re_tariff_2024.note: The regulation exists and is retained as a future source. No numerical value from it is used in this registry until individually verified.

pumped_storage.note: CEA notes hydro and pumped-storage candidate capex is project-specific; this range must not substitute for Kerala site costs.

bess_4h.note: The CEA table reports the 4-hour BESS cost trajectory as a range. This registry preserves the published values without silently assigning unverified year labels to each endpoint.

model_input_grid.rule: Null values are intentional. Final optimisation must fail input validation if a required techno-economic field is unresolved. External study benchmarks above are not defaults.

scenario_dimensions.note: No numerical capacity, demand, cost, transfer-limit or reliability answers are encoded here.
scenario_dimensions.rule: This file defines which levers differ between scenarios. It deliberately does not contain invented capacity ceilings, demand growth, costs, transfer limits or reliability thresholds. Numerical values enter only after a source or explicit scenario assumption is recorded in a dedicated input dataset.
unresolved_numeric_inputs: Kerala interstate transfer capability and derating cases
battery CAPEX OPEX efficiency lifetime and degradation
demand-response MW duration and rebound constraints
EV flexible charging energy and connection limits
reliability criterion and value of lost load

limitations: Daily replay is an accounting check, not chronological dispatch validation or 2040 optimisation.
Renewable profiles cover a UTC year and require explicit alignment to IST model intervals.
GIS raw-file presence is not a processed ecological exclusion map or capacity ceiling.
CSTEP pathways and costs remain external benchmarks; unresolved model inputs stay null.
